historical_record.description: The Office of the Assessor-Recorder photographed the property for tax assessment. Hotel Empire was at the address.
The York Hotel, one of three businesses where an attempt by Hotel Employees and Retail Employees Local 2 to organise workers was defeated in 1979-80.
The Empire Hotel, designed by Hertzka & Knowles.

unknowns: Hertzka & Knowles is recorded as having worked on the Empire Hotel, with no year given; the partnership was formed in 1933 and the assessor dates the building to 1925, so the work was not the original design.
